lines.text: Eliphaz the Temanite says Job once strengthened feeble hands, but now trouble has come and Job is weary and dismayed.
Eliphaz asks who innocent has ever perished, and says the wicked perish by the breath of God.
Eliphaz says a word came secretly in a vision at noon, and a spirit glided past his face.

wrong_details.true: in visions in the night, when deep sleep falls on men

lines.text: The whispering voice asks if a mortal can be more righteous than God, saying people are crushed like a moth.
Eliphaz says he would appeal to God, who will rescue Job from six calamities, and Job's offspring will be few.

wrong_details.true: Job's offspring will be many, like the grass of the earth
